about: Campaign Mode's recurring lines (docs/CAMPAIGN-MODE.md sections 4.4 and 7): Lola's morning-paper headlines, Papa-Dani's weekly reply (always warm, docs/CAST.md), the Mayor's ribbons and the team's grumbles. {candidate}, {points}, {place} and {name} are filled in.

up: BREAKING 🚨 {candidate} is up {points}. City Hall has ordered more ribbon.
Sources say {candidate} gained {points} this week. The Mayor's people are "not worried" (they're worried) 👀
Up {points}, babe. Somebody's campaign manager is cooking.
down: Oof. {candidate} slipped {points} this week. Allegedly, the campaign office smells like panic.
Down {points}. Papa-Dani is cutting ribbons and smiling about it.
{candidate} lost {points}. Darling, the city is watching. Do something.
flat: A quiet week. {candidate} held steady. The Mayor held a ribbon.
Flat polls, loud campaign. Something has to give, sweetie.
No movement this week. Lola is bored. Don't let Lola be bored.

up: Congratulations, neighbor! Good week for {candidate}. I'm still filling potholes!
You're climbing! Love that. My door's still open, by the way.
Three cheers for democracy! And for the new bike rack on 31st Street, which I opened today.
down: Tough week, neighbor. Want a coffee? I know a great diner. I cut the ribbon there.
Hang in there! Campaigns are hard. Potholes are harder. Ask me how I know.
Forty-one potholes this month, neighbor! Just saying.

neglect: Nobody from the campaign showed up in {place}. The Mayor did.
ribbon: Papa-Dani cut a ribbon on a repaired bench in {place}. The bench is doing well.
Papa-Dani opened a water fountain in {place}. It works. He drank from it twice.
Papa-Dani filled a pothole in {place} "personally" (his team did; he held the ribbon).
grumble: {name} is grumbling about the dirty stuff. Quietly, for now.
{name} asked if "this is who we are now." Nobody answered.
warning: {name} came to your desk: "I'll do this once. I won't do it every week." Consider yourself warned.
leak: Someone talked. {name} had lunch with a reporter, and now the Bugle is asking questions. Heat +8.

factCheck.debunked: The Borough Bugle fact-checked your story about the Mayor. It did not survive. -4 there, Integrity -8, Heat +15.
factCheck.held: The fake story held. For now.
